# A Synthetic Study of Repeatable Toy Evaluation

<!-- page: 1 -->

## Research question

Does a fixed seed make a toy evaluation repeatable?

## Method

Run the same deterministic program twice with seed 7 and record the accuracy.

<!-- page: 2 -->

## Result

Both runs report accuracy 0.75.

**Table 1.** The two runs have the same accuracy: run A = 0.75; run B = 0.75.

**Figure 1.** A flat line at accuracy 0.75 represents the two deterministic runs.

## Limitation

The fixture does not establish performance outside the toy data.
